$comment: Acceptance figures on the reference image, machine-readable. ValidationTests (trait Category=Validation, not in the gate, ADR 0004) reads this file; docs/validation.md explains each case and records every change. Two kinds. icc: IccPaperBlack.Read on the profile the case names as its image, figures icc.*. analysis: AnalysisRun.Execute on the image with the case's parameters (aspect, distanceM, dmax, medium, targetBg; absent = the core's default). image is a manifest name under the large test data folder, TestData.LargeDir (ADR 0088). expected lists the figures the case guards, by the names ValidationTests prints; tolerance applies to every numeric field that is not an integer; integers, booleans and strings are compared exactly; null means unmeasured. Change a figure here only after re-measuring and recording why in validation.md.

expected.curves.problem: Nu se sugereaza nicio curba: punctul "varfuri" e deja la 0.971, la sau peste 0.92, unde ajung varfurile dupa o curba. Nu mai e loc de contrast fara sa cobori ceva, iar curbele sugerate nu coboara niciun punct: imaginea e deja cat de luminoasa poate fi.
